title: Logistics Sales Executive
description:
Logistics Sales Executive Ipswich
Competitive salary
1 day WFH
Hours 9am 5.30 PM
Pension
Gym Discount
Social events
Private Medical

Helping businesses move forward. Quite literally!

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working with people, has a natural interest in business and sales, and wants to play an important role in supporting a busy Commercial and Sales team.

The position will involve identifying and researching new business opportunities, qualifying incoming leads, supporting the sales process and ensuring that potential customers are followed up and developed effectively.

Working closely with internal and external Commercial teams, the successful candidate will help connect the dots between marketing, sales and operations, ensuring opportunities are captured, developed and progressed.

It's a varied role that combines commercial awareness, customer communication, research, organisation and administration. No two days should look exactly the same!

This isn't simply about sending quotes and hoping for the best. It's about understanding businesses, identifying their challenges and demonstrating how the right logistics partner can make their supply chains work smarter, more efficiently and cost-effectively.

The Role

The successful candidate will act as a trusted logistics consultant, taking the time to understand customers' businesses and identifying opportunities to add genuine value.

With a comprehensive range of multimodal logistics solutions, including road, air, sea freight and customs services, the business has the expertise and flexibility to manage a wide variety of logistics requirements.

Responsibilities will include:
- Identifying, developing and winning new business opportunities across the UK.
- Building strong, long-term relationships with new and existing customers.
- Growing customer accounts by identifying additional service opportunities.
- Understanding customer supply chains and recommending efficient, cost-effective logistics solutions.
- Working with UK and overseas offices to develop commercial opportunities.
- Preparing tailored proposals and presenting solutions to prospective customers.
- Managing and maintaining the CRM system (Zoho Bigin) and sales pipeline.
- Following up marketing-generated leads and developing new opportunities.
- Attending exhibitions, trade shows and networking events.
- Reviewing customer requirements and gathering relevant information to help develop suitable, cost-effective logistics solutions.
- Preparing commercial information, reports and proposals to support the wider team.
- Providing general commercial and administrative support to ensure the smooth running of the sales function.

Experience & Skills

The business is looking for someone with a positive attitude, strong organisational skills and a genuine interest in developing within a commercial environment.

Previous experience in logistics, freight forwarding, sales support, customer service or administration would be advantageous, but attitude, ability and willingness to learn are equally important.

Ideally, candidates will have:
- Experience in logistics, freight forwarding, import/export or commercial sales.
- An understanding of international trade, Incoterms and supply chain processes.
- Excellent communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills.
- Strong commercial awareness and the ability to identify new opportunities.

The Opportunity

Joining a hardworking, ambitious and growing business, the successful candidate will have the opportunity to take ownership of their customer portfolio, explore new markets and make a genuine contribution to the company's commercial growth.

This is a role for someone who wants to do more than sell freight. Someone who enjoys solving problems, building partnerships and helping businesses improve the way they move their goods.

If you're commercially switched on, enjoy a challenge and want to be part of an ambitious logistics business with exciting plans for the future, this could be the perfect next move.

After all, the world isn't going to move itself!

title: Sales & Business Development Executive
salary_text: £28000 - £30000 per year (discretionary bonus based on perform)
description:
Just Recruitment is delighted to be partnering with a thriving and ambitious business on the outskirts of Ipswich to recruit a Sales & Business Development Executive.
This is an excellent opportunity for a customer-focused and commercially minded individual to join a growing team, supporting client relationships, account management and new business development.
Key Responsibilities
Quotation Management: Prepare and issue accurate service quotations, ensuring customers receive timely and professional responses.
CRM Management: Maintain accurate and up-to-date sales pipeline information, ensuring client details, contact records and contract terms are correctly recorded.
Client Onboarding: Act as a key point of contact for new and existing customers, ensuring service agreements are completed, signed and filed appropriately.
Customer Retention & Account Management: Conduct regular check-in calls and account reviews to monitor customer satisfaction, strengthen relationships and identify opportunities to introduce additional waste management services.
Pricing & Customer Queries: Handle pricing enquiries, including price increase discussions, providing clear explanations and maintaining positive customer relationships.
Internal Liaison: Work closely with the Sales, Transport and Accounts teams to ensure effective communication and seamless service delivery.
Account Development: Review existing customer accounts to identify opportunities for growth, improve service levels and maximise customer retention.
Required Skills & Experience
Customer Service: Proven experience handling customer enquiries professionally, taking ownership of queries from initial contact through to resolution and ensuring a positive customer experience.
Administrative Excellence: Strong organisational skills, excellent attention to detail and a right-first-time approach, particularly when handling customer records, contracts and waste documentation where accuracy is essential for compliance.
Communication Skills: The ability to communicate confidently and professionally, explaining service information and compliance requirements clearly to customers.
IT Skills: Confident using CRM systems, such as Salesforce or HubSpot, alongside Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
Relationship Management: The ability to build and maintain strong customer relationships, identify opportunities to develop existing accounts and contribute to long-term business growth.
Commercial Awareness: A proactive approach to identifying additional service opportunities while balancing customer satisfaction with business objectives.

title: Sales Executive
description:
Sales Executive

About the Role

Large manufacturing company is looking for a motivated and commercially minded Sales Executive to join their growing division. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys building strong customer relationships, identifying new business opportunities, and delivering tailored solutions to meet customer needs.

Working closely with the team, you will play a key role in driving sales, managing projects from initial enquiry through to completion, and developing relationships with both existing customers and new clients.

The role offers a varied mix of sales, business development, technical quotation work, supplier liaison, and customer engagement, including office and site visits.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage the full sales cycle for all products, from initial enquiry and quotation through to order completion.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with existing customers while identifying and developing new business opportunities.
- Respond promptly and professionally to customer enquiries by telephone, email, and in person.
- Interpret technical drawings and prepare accurate, competitive project quotations.
- Develop a thorough understanding of our products, manufacturing processes, and technical capabilities.
- Obtain and compare costs from existing and new suppliers, supporting effective procurement.
- Maintain commercial awareness and develop a strong network of industry contacts.
- Use Barbour ABI to identify potential projects, leads, and business development opportunities.
- Visit customers and clients for office meetings and site visits.
- Support the company's presence at trade shows, industry events, and CPD presentations.
- Work collaboratively with colleagues across the department to support sales growth and customer satisfaction.
- Maintain high standards of accuracy, professionalism, confidentiality, and adherence to company quality, health and safety, and environmental policies.

About You
- They are looking for someone who is proactive, organised, and confident communicating with customers and colleagues.
- You will have a commercial mindset, a strong customer focus, and the ability to manage multiple enquiries and projects effectively.
- Experience in a sales, business development, or customer-facing commercial role.
- Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to prioritise workloads and meet deadlines.
- Good numerical skills and attention to detail when preparing quotations and sourcing costs.
- The ability to understand technical drawings, or a willingness to develop this skill.
- A proactive approach to identifying new business opportunities and developing customer relationships.
- Confidence working independently while contributing positively to a team.
- Experience in construction, precast concrete, retaining walls, or a related technical sales environment would be advantageous. Familiarity with Barbour ABI would also be beneficial

title: Customer Service Apprentice
description:
Job Type: Apprenticeship
Location: Bury St Edmunds
Hours: 40 hours per week, Monday Friday
Apprenticeship wage & Benefits

At Hayley Dexis we ve built-up our reputation over the course of the last five decades with stock, service and people at the core of everything we do.

We are entering an exciting period of growth and our 1300 people, doing things the Hayley Way along with industry leading customer service are central to our success.

We re excited to offer a brilliant opportunity for a Customer Service Apprentice working within a busy and supportive branch environment.

About the Customer Service Apprentice role:

As a Customer Service Apprentice, you ll gain hands-on experience across key areas of the branch, building the skills needed to deliver excellent service to our customers. You will rotate through:
- Trade Counter supporting and serving customers face-to-face
- Internal Sales / Office handling calls, emails, and customer enquiries
- Warehouse Operations understanding stock, order fulfilment, and logistics

This well-rounded approach ensures you develop a strong understanding of both our products and how we support customers from enquiry through to delivery.

You ll learn how to:
- Communicate confidently with customers and colleagues
- Handle enquiries, orders and problem-solving effectively
- Use internal systems and processes
- Deliver a high standard of customer service in a fast-paced environment

Following successful completion, there may be the opportunity to progress into a Customer Service or Internal Sales role.

About the Apprenticeship:
- Customer Service Specialists level 3
- Duration: typically, 15 months
- Study and coursework completed during working hours
- Regular support from a training provider and your manager

What we re looking for in our Customer Service Apprentice:
- A genuine interest in customer service and building a career
- Enthusiastic, motivated and willing to learn
- Good communication skills (verbal and written)
- GCSEs (or equivalent) in English and Maths
- Basic IT skills (including Microsoft Office)
- Strong attention to detail and logical thinking
- Well-presented and professional approach
- Able to travel to and work locally

No prior experience is required just the right attitude and commitment to learning.

What you ll get in return:
- Apprenticeship salary
- 23 days annual leave (plus public/bank holidays)
- Uniform and PPE provided
- Training and development provided through our own Hayley Academy

What to expect from our recruitment process:
- Initial screening

- Decision outcome

We ll close this role on Sunday 22nd November, but may do so earlier if we receive strong interest so don t miss out.

A final note

Not sure you tick every box? Please don t let that stop you from applying.

title: General Aviation Account Manager
description:
General Aviation Account Manager

This role within WTW's Global Aviation & Space team focuses on General Aviation risks, offering insurance solutions for regional airlines, corporate jets, and rotor wing operators. The position is based in Ipswich, and the successful candidate will be responsible for managing a portfolio of General Aviation accounts, handling new business, renewals, client management, and broking.
The Role
- Global Aviation & Space is a specialist team within WTW focusing on Airline, Aerospace, Inspace and General Aviation risks.
- This role is within the General Aviation Practice which provides insurance solutions for regional airlines, corporate jet and rotor wing operators.
- Based in Ipswich, an exciting opportunity has become available for an individual to join our Aerospace Practice.
- The successful incumbent will have responsibility for a portfolio of General Aviation accounts handling all aspects of clients' insurance programmes in a timely, technically proficient, accurate and compliant manner.
- This will include but not be restricted to: new business enquiries; client renewals; client management and broking.
- This position is focused on supporting and developing client relationships by providing quality technical administrative and service support directly to Clients, Insurers and Account Executives.

What you'll bring
- Ability to negotiate premiums and coverage with insurers on behalf of clients.
- Confident in advising clients with the ability to engage and form strong relationships
- Experience in a client-facing role preferrable but not essential, can be in either supporting or managing an assigned client portfolio.
- Provide excellent client service.
- Be able to work in a deadline driven environment.
- Be confident user of MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
- Have excellent organisational, PC and communications skills.
- ACII qualified or studying towards is preferred but not essential

What we offer

Enjoy a benefits package designed to help you thrive, both professionally and personally. You'll receive 25 days of annual leave plus an extra WTW day to relax and recharge. Our comprehensive health and wellbeing offering includes private healthcare, life insurance, group income protection, and regular health assessments, all giving you peace of mind. Secure your future with our defined contribution pension scheme, featuring matched contributions up to 10% from the company.

We support your growth and balance with hybrid working options, access to an employee assistance programme, and a fully paid volunteer day to make a difference in your community. On top of these, you can opt into a variety of additional perks including an electric vehicle car scheme, share scheme, cycle-to-work programme, dental and optical cover, critical illness protection, and much more. Start making the most of your career and wellbeing with a range of benefits tailored for you.
